name: Massive (formerly Polygon.io)
rate_limits: Free Currencies Basic: 5 API calls a minute (source: https://massive.com/pricing?product=currencies).
history_start: 2 years of history on the free plan.
what_it_has: All forex and crypto tickers with end of day data, minute bars, reference data and technical indicators on the free plan. Polygon renamed itself Massive on 2025-10-30; old keys and api.polygon.io still work.
simple: A market data company with a free plan for currency prices, but it only goes back two years.
license_terms: Free plans are for individual use only. https://massive.com/pricing?product=currencies
quality_notes: Two years is too short for a strategy test. Both api.polygon.io and api.massive.com run in parallel for now.

relevance.reason: Free minute FX bars, but only two years deep.
